cards.ex: He always tries to pull rank on junior employees, making them do all the unpleasant tasks.
cards.exUz: U har doim quyi xodimlarga nisbatan o'z mansabidan foydalanib, ularga yoqimsiz vazifalarni yuklaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'z mansabini suiiste'mol qilib, boshqalarga bosim o'tkazish.

cards.ex: A good leader doesn't just give orders; they lead by example and work alongside their team.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi yetakchi faqat buyruq bermaydi; u o'rnak bo'lib, jamoasi bilan birga ishlaydi.

cards.ex: The country's influence is largely based on soft power, like its films and music.
cards.exUz: Mamlakatning ta'siri asosan uning filmlari va musiqasi kabi yumshoq kuchga asoslangan.
cards.uzDef: Madaniyat va qadriyatlar orqali ta'sir o'tkazish.

cards.ex: If you want to stay in his good graces, you'll have to toe the line and agree with everything he says.
cards.exUz: Agar siz uning nazarida qolmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qoidalarga rioya qilishingiz va u aytgan hamma narsaga rozi bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga qat'iy rioya qilish, itoat etish.

cards.ex: Coming from a wealthy family gave him a leg up in the business world.
cards.exUz: Boy oiladan chiqqani unga biznes dunyosida ustunlik berdi.

cards.ex: The politician's team is working hard on spin control after the scandal broke.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining jamoasi janjal chiqqanidan keyin axborotni boshqarish ustida qattiq ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Salbiy xabarlarni ijobiy tomonga o'zgartirish harakati.

cards.ex: Many consider the current government to be a puppet regime controlled by foreign interests.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik hozirgi hukumatni xorijiy manfaatlar tomonidan boshqariladigan qo'g'irchoq rejim deb hisoblaydi.

cards.ex: The campaign started slowly, but it's finally gaining traction with the public.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya sekin boshlandi, lekin nihoyat jamoatchilik orasida mashhurlikka erishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: G'oya, loyiha yoki harakat mashhurlikka erishishi.

cards.ex: She led the charge for reform in the company, pushing for more ethical practices.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyada islohotlar uchun rahbarlik qildi va axloqiy amaliyotlarni kuchaytirishga intildi.
cards.uzDef: Hujumni yoki loyihani boshqarish, oldinda borish.

cards.ex: Negotiating from a position of strength gives you the upper hand.
cards.exUz: Kuch pozitsiyasidan kelib chiqib muzokara olib borish sizga ustunlik beradi.

cards.ex: We shouldn't put politicians on a pedestal; they're still human beings.
cards.exUz: Biz siyosatchilarni juda hurmat qilmasligimiz kerak; ular ham inson.

cards.ex: Everyone knows he's the power behind the throne; the king just does what he's told.
cards.exUz: Hamma biladi, u taxt ortidagi asosiy kuch; qirol faqat unga aytilganini qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy lavozimda bo'lmasdan, asosiy ta'sir o'tkazuvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: I didn't mean to bend your ear for so long about my problems.
cards.exUz: Men sizni muammolarim haqida bunchalik ko'p gapirib zeriktirmoqchi emasdim.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir uzoq vaqt gap bilan zeriktirmoq.

cards.ex: I don't want to rock the boat, but I think we need to address these issues.
cards.exUz: Men vaziyatni buzmoqchi emasman, lekin bu masalalarni hal qilishimiz kerak deb o'ylayman.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni o'zgartirishga harakat qilib, muammo chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: He tried to win her over with flowers and chocolates, but she wasn't interested.
cards.exUz: U uni gullar va shokoladlar bilan ko'ndirishga harakat qildi, lekin u qiziqmadi.

cards.ex: The dictator's death created a power vacuum in the country.
cards.exUz: Diktatorning o'limi mamlakatda hokimiyat bo'shlig'ini yaratdi.

cards.ex: The company car is at your disposal for business trips.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya mashinasi sizning biznes safarlaringiz uchun ixtiyoringizda.

cards.ex: Everyone loves to root for the underdog in a competition.
cards.exUz: Hamma musobaqada omadsizlar uchun jon kuydirishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonishi kutilmaydigan shaxs yoki guruh.

cards.ex: The politician's power base is in the rural areas of the state.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining tayanch nuqtasi shtatning qishloq hududlarida.
cards.uzDef: Ta'sirni amalga oshirish uchun tayanch bo'lgan shaxslar yoki joylar.

cards.ex: A little bribe can sometimes grease the wheels of bureaucracy.
cards.exUz: Ozroq pora ba'zan byurokratiya ishini tezlashtirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ishni tezlashtirish yoki osonlashtirish uchun harakat qilish.

cards.ex: After the CEO retired, his daughter took the reins of the company.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor nafaqaga chiqqanidan so'ng, uning qizi kompaniya boshqaruvini o'z qo'liga oldi.

cards.ex: The actor's fall from grace was swift after the scandal was revealed.
cards.exUz: Aktyorning obro'sizlanishi janjal ochilgandan so'ng tez sodir bo'ldi.

cards.ex: He gave in to peer pressure and started smoking.
cards.exUz: U tengdoshlarining bosimiga berilib, chekishni boshladi.

cards.ex: The media has the power to sway public opinion on important issues.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari muhim masalalarda jamoatchilik fikrini o'zgartirish kuchiga ega.

cards.ex: The gang tried to muscle in on their territory and take over their operations.
cards.exUz: Guruh ularning hududiga kuch ishlatib aralashib, operatsiyalarini o'z qo'liga olishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir biznesiga yoki hududiga kuch ishlatib aralashish.

cards.ex: You'll have to get permission from the powers that be before you can make any changes.
cards.exUz: Har qanday o'zgarish qilishdan oldin siz yuqori doiralardan ruxsat olishingiz kerak.

cards.ex: He felt like a pawn in a game between the two powerful corporations.
cards.exUz: U o'zini ikki qudratli korporatsiya o'rtasidagi o'yinda qurbon deb his qildi.

cards.ex: The independent board members help keep the CEO in check.
cards.exUz: Mustaqil kengash a'zolari bosh direktorning nazorat ostida bo'lishiga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir nazorat ostida ushlab turish, cheklash.

cards.ex: The new regulations are intended to level the playing field for small businesses.
cards.exUz: Yangi qoidalar kichik biznes uchun teng sharoit yaratishga qaratilgan.

cards.ex: We need to treat everyone on equal footing, regardless of their background.
cards.exUz: Biz hamma bilan teng huquqli munosabatda bo'lishimiz kerak, kelib chiqishidan qat'i nazar.
